text.formal: Address the reader formally. No difference between tutorials and technical pages.

style.loanwords_text: Keep established crypto loanwords (e.g. blockchain, token); explain them briefly in Igbo at first use. The terminology list below wins over this rule.
writing_rules: Never put English in brackets inside a Markdown link label: [Igbo text](url) is correct, [Igbo text [English]](url) is wrong and breaks the link.
Add the English term in brackets only the FIRST time it appears in each page, not every time.
